cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs include fields such as record_id n06-r01, demand_score 9, source_id s01, source_weight 5.
Job 2 output coverage entries retain only capability_id, coverage, need, and record_id, omitting demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
Job 2 output priorities entries also omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight.
Every Job 2 priority entry has upstream_rank: 0 despite evidence_sources providing ranks 1 through 8.
initial_receipt.explanation: Job 2 received all eight need records with demand_score, source_id, source_weight, plus ranked evidence_sources, but its output dropped the provenance fields from coverage and priorities and set every priority upstream_rank to 0. That violates the requirements to preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, source_weight and deterministic source provenance/rank order. The evidence does not identify an exact function name.
